attchmntText: Wakefit Innovations Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Wakefit Innovations Limited approved unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board meeting was held on November 12, 2026. Revenue from operations for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, was 4,519.93 million, compared to 4,049.11 million in the previous quarter. Profit before tax for the quarter was 265.44 million, compared to 363.05 million in the previous quarter. Earnings per share for the quarter was 0.48 basic and 0.47 diluted. For the half year ended September 30, 2026, revenue from operations was 8,569.04 million. Profit before tax for the half year was 628.49 million. Earnings per share for the half year was 1.18 basic and 1.18 diluted. The results were reviewed by M/s B S R & Co. LLP. The company completed an initial public offering on December 15, 2025.

attchmntText: Wakefit Innovations Limited has informed the Exchange about Earnings Conference Call for Q2 FY27 is scheduled to be held on November 13, 2026.
